notes.title: 1.6 update
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix missing avatar hands on HTC Vive and other non-Oculus headsets.
[*] Add instructions and hints to all levels to make it easier to learn how to get through the level.
[*] 1-5: Add missing wall collider that allowed a shortcut. High scores taking this shortcut has been reset.
[/list]
